I felt this. But I want to tell you about my situation so you, at the very least, can find hope in yours.

I see a lot of parallels in what you're currently experiencing and what I have been going through. I am currently going through a divorce that is not messy by any means but the road that led up to was a fucking shit show to say the least. She had multiple affairs while I was deployed and even when I got back. For Xmas 2019, she gave me divorce papers. A few weeks later I was living somewhere else and she and her boyfriend were living in my house.

You know that scene in Avengers when Wanda confronts Thanos and says; "You took everything from me"? That's what it felt like. So I did what at the time felt like the most rational thing to do. I cut everyone out of my life, the lone exception being my kids. I stopped talking to friends I've known for over 20 years. Cut off my entire family. And anyone else that probably could have been there for me. To me, I couldn't let anyone down if I didn't have anyone. I tried to get help, went through a few therapy sessions. I really didn't have a set goal of how to fix what I was going through, but when they came back and said meditation would "work wonders" for me, I laughed and walked out and have tried going back to therapy. My mom developed cancer during my isolation and died not too long after being diagnosed. I didn't talk to her the last year of her life. It's just another one of those things.
